338	func (m *Manager) Stop() {
339		m.mtxScrape.Lock()

344		// pools with high number of targets.
345		// Limit the number of pools stopping at once to avoid unbounded goroutines.
346		g := new(errgroup.Group)
347		g.SetLimit(runtime.GOMAXPROCS(0))

350				sp.stop()
351				return nil
352			})
353		}
354		_ = g.Wait()
